Subject: Voucher recon and options for unused cohort credits

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well — quick one from our side. We ran the spring cohort and have ~320,000 unused voucher tokens across 12 teams (summary attached). The program guide references that vouchers expire at the end of the cohort, but several founders are moving to paid pilots faster than anticipated.

Can Redwood:
- convert a portion of the unused vouchers to a 6-month committed discount (applied as monthly bill credits), or
- alternatively allow a refund/credit to our IgniteHub account to be applied to platform invoices?

We know promo T&Cs usually limit cash refunds — looking for any flexibility for a program partner. If there's a standard conversion rate or carveout we can propose to founders, send it over and we'll route approvals on our side.

Attachments: IgniteHub_Voucher_Report_May2028.csv (CSV)

Quick ask: can you put options in writing this week? We have a board review next Thursday and want to show a path.

Thanks,
Rebecca Singh

Hi Rebecca — thanks for the export, that helps. Looping in Ben (sales) and Laura (finance/legal) to surface options and implications.

Initial thoughts — possible approaches we can evaluate quickly:
1) Conversion to committed monthly credits: convert X% of voucher value into an equivalent committed spend over N months at a discounted rate (e.g., convert $10k voucher value -> $6k over 6 months). This preserves spend and is accounting-friendly.
2) Account credit: issue a non-refundable account credit that IgniteHub can apply to future invoices (limited by internal policy).
3) Refund: generally restricted; would require approvals and will need tax/invoice treatment.

Ben/Laura — can you confirm: (A) the maximum % of voucher face value we can convert under existing promo terms without legal sign-off; (B) whether a one-off credit to partner accounts is permissible; and (C) any billing/invoice flow to propose (we may need a short DocuSign amendment).

Rebecca — if you can share a prioritized list (convert first, credit second, refund last) and whether founders require individual legal docs, that will speed things.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Kim, Rebecca — reviewed the attached spend. A pragmatic commercial solution we can offer now without full legal amendment:

Option A (preferred, quick):
- Convert up to 60% of unused voucher face value into a 6-month committed credit applied monthly to the IgniteHub master account.
- Converted value carries a 40% haircut (i.e., redeem $100 -> $60 in committed credit).
- No cash refunds.
- We issue a short conversion amendment (DocuSign) with a simple statement of credits and effective dates.

Option B (account credit):
- Issue a non-expiring account credit equal to up to 30% of voucher face value. Usable on platform invoices; cannot be refunded.

Rationale: keeps revenue visibility for Redwood and gives IgniteHub runway to migrate founders. If this is acceptable I'll draft the term sheet and add the finance checklist.

Attachments: Proposed_Conversion_TermSheet_v1.pdf (PDF)

Ben Carter
Director, GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Ben/Kim — flagged a couple of compliance and billing items:
- Promo T&Cs: current voucher terms (promo id: IGN-SPR28) state vouchers are non-transferable and expire at cohort end. Any conversion is an exception and needs a signed amendment.
- Revenue recognition: if we convert vouchers to committed credits, treat as deferred revenue over the 6-month commitment. Finance will need invoice preview (sample attached).
- VAT/Tax: if we issue account credits or refunds, tax treatment differs by entity. Need IgniteHub's billing address and VAT id.
- Legal: one-off refunds are allowed only with VP finance sign-off; account credits/conversions are quicker.

I'll prepare the finance checklist and sample invoice flows. Ben — if you want to go ahead, approve Option A in thread and I'll kick off the amendment template + accounting entries.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

Kim/Ben/Laura — thanks, that path looks workable. IgniteHub preference is:
1) Option A for up to 60% conversion (we accept the 40% haircut) for the cohort balance. That gives founders time on-platform.
2) For remaining 40%, please issue a non-expiring account credit to IgniteHub for internal admin use.

Action items we need:
- Short amendment (DocuSign) that we can sign by EOD Friday (please include the conversion schedule and effective dates).
- Sample invoice showing deferral schedule and how the credit will appear.
- Confirmation of tax/VAT fields to populate.

Attachments: Invoice_preview_IGN-095.xlsx (Excel)
